clue.text: Don't be such a baby — not with team

indicators.note: not tells us the abbreviation for with is to be left out of the phrase

parts.note: the stock rebuke to a childish person is 'Grow up!'

explanation.surface: Someone scolds a whiny teammate, or tells a sulker to stop acting like a baby and leave the team.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not with' removes W from GROW UP.
explanation.definitionFit: A group is a band of people acting together, as a team is.

clue.text: Entrance German goddess

parts.note: Ate is the Greek goddess of mischief and ruin

explanation.surface: A grand doorway named after a German goddess.
explanation.walkthrough: Ate, the Greek goddess of folly and ruin, is a crossword regular.
explanation.definitionFit: A gate is a way in through a wall or fence, an entrance.

clue.text: City's focus as guard to dungeon US regularly used

indicators.note: regularly used means only every other letter of the following words is taken, here the second, fourth and so on

explanation.surface: A city's attention is on guarding a prison used by the Americans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly used' takes the even letters of 'focus as guard to dungeon US', spelling the capital of Burkina Faso in West Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Ouagadougou is the capital city of Burkina Faso.

clue.text: Astronaut losing head then heart to computer game

indicators.note: losing head then heart says the word drops its first letter and then its middle letter

parts.note: a spaceman is an astronaut

explanation.surface: A spaceman loses his nerve and his wits and turns to a video game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'losing head then heart' removes S, the first letter, then E, the central letter of SPACEMAN.
explanation.definitionFit: Pac-Man is the classic 1980 arcade video game of a yellow disc eating dots in a maze.

clue.text: Film tempers their irritation announcing president's return

indicators.note: irritation suggests the words tempers their are stirred up and rearranged

parts.note: Ike was the nickname of US President Dwight Eisenhower, so the president's is Ike's
a return is a coming back, so 'Ike's back' announces his return

explanation.surface: A movie loses its temper while someone proclaims a president has come back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'irritation' rearranges TEMPERS THEIR into THE EMPIRE STR; 'announcing president's return' is the declaration IKE'S BACK, Ike being Eisenhower.
explanation.definitionFit: The Empire Strikes Back is the 1980 second Star Wars movie.

clue.text: Colour left unknown in card game

indicators.note: in tells us the left-and-unknown pair sit inside the colour word

parts.note: a tone is a shade of colour
went means left, departed
Y is one of the algebraic unknowns

explanation.surface: A colour left unidentified during a game of cards.
explanation.walkthrough: 'left' looks like the direction but is the past tense of go.
explanation.definitionFit: Twenty-one is another name for blackjack or pontoon, a casino card game.

clue.text: Exeter dropping a couple of points before getting one more

indicators.note: before getting puts what remains in front of the next piece
dropping means the city name loses these letters

parts.note: E is east, a compass point, so two points are two Es
A means one

explanation.surface: Exeter's football team slips two points but then gains one more.
explanation.walkthrough: Exeter is a city in Devon, south-west England; 'points' looks like league points but means compass points, E for east.
explanation.definitionFit: Extra is additional, over and above, so more of something.

clue.text: Alchemi needs large cinema organ

parts.note: the setter is Alchemi, so the setter speaking of himself gives me
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large
Odeon is a British cinema chain, and an odeon is a cinema

explanation.surface: The setter wants a big cinema organ to play.
explanation.walkthrough: Setters often refer to themselves to signal ME. ODEON is a British cinema chain whose name came to mean a cinema.
explanation.definitionFit: A melodeon is a small reed organ, or button accordion, worked by bellows.

clue.text: Reserved some bicycles

indicators.note: some means only part of the word bicycles is taken, a run inside it

explanation.surface: A few bicycles were set aside.
explanation.definitionFit: An icy manner is cold and distant, so a reserved person can seem frosty.

clue.text: Old urgent saying

parts.note: ex means former, old
pressing means urgent

explanation.surface: An old proverb with an urgent message.
explanation.definitionFit: Expressing a thought is putting it into words, so saying it.

clue.text: Some in government ran checks on funding instalment

indicators.note: Some in says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Government officials audit the release of a payment in stages.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition included 'on', which cannot stand for the answer; 'on' is a link word joining wordplay to 'funding instalment'.
explanation.definitionFit: A tranche is one portion of a sum of money paid out in stages.

clue.text: Compile scores, ending in arrogant colleague winning

indicators.note: ending in means only the final letter of the word arrogant is taken

parts.note: an ally is a colleague or associate
up means ahead, winning, as in two goals up

explanation.surface: A cocky teammate's victory leads to the scores being totalled.
explanation.definitionFit: To tally up is to add up a total, as of points in a game.

clue.text: Puzzling advert against cultural innovator

indicators.note: puzzling suggests the letters of advert against are jumbled into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A baffling advertisement attacks a pioneer of the arts.
explanation.definitionFit: An avant-gardiste is a member of the avant-garde, an innovator in art or culture.

clue.text: See 4
Fellow leaves donkey wilted, without energy — that's sweet!

indicators.note: leaves means the fellow departs from the word donkey

parts.note: a don is a fellow of a college

indicators.note: without here means outside, so the wilted word goes round the letter for energy

parts.note: limp means wilted, drooping
E is the physics symbol for energy
i.e., id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A wilting donkey, drained of energy after its keeper goes, is a sweet sight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' means outside: LIMP goes round E for LIMEP. 'that's' is i.e. A key lime pie is an American dessert.
explanation.definitionFit: Key lime pie is a pudding of lime custard in a pastry case, so a sweet in the British dessert sense.

clue.text: Personalities say nothing succeeded

parts.note: e.g. means for example, say
O is zero, nothing
S is the abbreviation for succeeded, as in family trees

explanation.surface: Famous people claim nothing worked.
explanation.definitionFit: The ego is the self, so egos are the selves or personalities of people.

clue.text: Nothing in unfashionable poets' motors

parts.note: out means no longer in fashion

indicators.note: in means the letter for nothing goes inside the poets

parts.note: bards are poets
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: Old-fashioned poets have no engines at all.
explanation.definitionFit: Outboards are outboard motors, engines clamped to the back of small boats.

clue.text: Offensive 22 sets off

indicators.note: off suggests the letters are set wrong and must be rearranged

parts.note: the answer to 22 down is a scientific unit, the tesla

explanation.surface: A rude scientist's unit triggers something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' shuffles the letters of TESLA (the answer to 22 down) and SETS together.
explanation.definitionFit: Tasteless jokes are in bad taste and may cause offence.

clue.text: Household pet needs a couple of whips

parts.note: with whips, names two whips; the first is a kitty, the pool filled by a whip-round
the second whip is the cat, the cat o' nine tails used for flogging

explanation.surface: A domestic animal requires a pair of whips.
explanation.walkthrough: A whip-round is a collection of money among a group, which fills a kitty; the cat is the cat o' nine tails, a flogging lash.
explanation.definitionFit: Kitty-cat is a childish word for a cat, the commonest household pet.

clue.text: Poem about food beginning to show model quality

indicators.note: about means the poem goes round the food

parts.note: lines are verses, a poem
an egg is a food

indicators.note: beginning to means only the first letter of show is taken

explanation.surface: A poem on food prefaces a catwalk show.
explanation.definitionFit: Long legs are a prized trait in fashion models, and legginess is having long legs.

clue.text: Hide second family

parts.note: kin means family, relations

explanation.surface: A second family is kept hidden.
explanation.definitionFit: A hide is an animal's skin, used for leather.

clue.text: Daughter quietly interrupts pulse with hospital equipment

indicators.note: interrupts means these letters break into the middle of the pulse

parts.note: a bean is a pulse, an edible seed
p, piano, is the musical direction for quietly

explanation.surface: A daughter quietly takes a patient's pulse with hospital gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pulse' looks medical but is the bean; D and P go inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A bedpan is the receptacle used by a bedridden patient in a hospital ward.

clue.text: How cameraman prepares apparatus for big explosion

definitions.meaning: respaced as ..., what a camera operator does to set up the camera
the volcano in Washington State whose 1980 eruption was enormous

explanation.surface: A cameraman readies his gear to film a massive blast.
explanation.walkthrough: The first reading needs the answer respaced as MOUNTS THE LENS.
explanation.definitionFit: Mount St Helens is the US volcano that erupted catastrophically in May 1980.

clue.text: Apparently commission the French scientific unit

indicators.note: Apparently stands for 'up' here: the word set appears upward in this down clue, so reads backwards

parts.note: to set up an inquiry is to commission it; the 'up' is to be read from the reversal in this down clue
la is a French word for the

explanation.surface: A French scientific unit seemingly ordered something.
explanation.walkthrough: Commission means set up; 'Apparently' signals that in a down entry SET appears 'up', reading TES.
explanation.definitionFit: The tesla is the SI unit of magnetic flux density, named after Nikola Tesla.

clue.text: Where lawyers gather among Poles

parts.note: in means among
N and S are the north and south poles

explanation.surface: Lawyers gathering in Poland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poles' looks like the nationality but is the two geographic poles. The Inns of Court are the four London societies to which every English barrister belongs.
explanation.definitionFit: Barristers in England are members of the Inns of Court, where lawyers gather.

clue.text: Royalty charges include November

indicators.note: include means the charges hold the letter for November inside

parts.note: prices are charges
N is November in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: Royal fees go up in November.
explanation.definitionFit: Princes are male members of a royal family, so royalty.

clue.text: Industry's foremost visionary cleared out plant

indicators.note: foremost means the first letter of Industry's is taken
cleared out means the middle of visionary is emptied, leaving its outer letters

explanation.surface: A leading industrialist with vision clears out a factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plant' looks like a factory but is the greenery.
explanation.definitionFit: Ivy is a climbing evergreen plant.

clue.text: Give reasons for experimental network covering Italy

parts.note: exp is an abbreviation for experimental

indicators.note: covering means the network goes round the letter for Italy

parts.note: a LAN is a local area network
I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: Justifying a trial computer network that spans Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: To explain something is to account for it, to give reasons for it.

clue.text: Pet saying involved Africans

indicators.note: involved means twisted and intricate, so the letters of pet saying are rearranged

explanation.surface: A favourite proverb is complicated for some Africans.
explanation.definitionFit: Egyptians are people of Egypt, a country in north-east Africa.

clue.text: Bombs northern country explodes externally

parts.note: UK, the United Kingdom, is a country

indicators.note: externally means only the outside letters of explodes are taken

explanation.surface: A country in the north blows up with bombs.
explanation.definitionFit: Nukes is informal for nuclear weapons, atomic bombs.
